weakeners_or_cancellations: Counted among the harmful yogas for electional work (Muhurta Chintamani ch. 1 v.34-35: first half avoided).
BPHS treats birth in this yoga as inauspicious and prescribes remedies (ch. 85, 88).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (English tr., archive.org 'ParasharaHoraSastra' text; chapter numbers as in that edition), ch. 85 sl. 1-4; ch. 88 sl. 1-5
source_views.view: Birth in Parigha is named among the 'inauspicious yogas' whose evil effects need remedy (ch. 88 sl. 1-5). Remedy: worship of Vishnu, a ghee lamp and abhisheka in a Shiva temple, walking round a pipal tree 108 times, havan, feeding Brahmins, done when the same yoga recurs.

disagreements: Jataka Bharanam gives Parigha a largely mixed birth reading, while BPHS lists it among inauspicious yogas needing remedy.
phrasing_guidance: Mention briefly as a tendency, if at all; nitya yoga is a minor factor next to the chart. Where a text calls the yoga inauspicious, present it as a traditional caution with a devotional remedy, never as a fixed misfortune or a health prediction.

remedies.remedy: Vishnu puja, ghee lamp and abhisheka at a Shiva temple, 108 rounds of a pipal tree, havan with a Vishnu mantra, feeding Brahmins; done on the day the same yoga recurs
